title: Freya and the Visitor
author: Beatrix Lockridge
blurb: Bram Ravensworth, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
